title: Bashan
sourceLines: -A region east of the Jordan River and north of the Arnon River Ge 14:5
-Allotted to the two and one half tribes, which had their possession east of the Jordan River Nu 32:33; De 3:10-14; Jos 12:4-6; 13:29-31; 17:1
-Invaded and taken by Hazael, king of Syria 2Ki 10:32,33
-Fertility and productiveness of Isa 33:9; Jer 50:19; Na 1:4
-Distinguished for its fine cattle De 32:14; Ps 22:12; Eze 39:8; Am 4:1; Mic 7:14
